compose:
name: cmdd
services:
  cassandra-1:
    container_name: cassandra-1
    environment:
      CASSANDRA_CLUSTER_NAME: consistency-cluster
      CASSANDRA_DC: datacenter1
      CASSANDRA_RACK: rack1
      CASSANDRA_SEEDS: cassandra-1
      HEAP_NEWSIZE: 200M
      MAX_HEAP_SIZE: 1G
    hostname: cassandra-1
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - cqlsh
        - 127.0.0.1
        - "9042"
        - -e
        - SELECT release_version FROM system.local;
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 2m0s
    image: cassandra:5.0.9
    networks:
      cassandra-network: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 9042
        published: "10001"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: cassandra1-data
        target: /var/lib/cassandra
        volume: {}
  cassandra-2:
    container_name: cassandra-2
    depends_on:
      cassandra-1:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CASSANDRA_CLUSTER_NAME: consistency-cluster
      CASSANDRA_DC: datacenter1
      CASSANDRA_RACK: rack1
      CASSANDRA_SEEDS: cassandra-1
      HEAP_NEWSIZE: 200M
      MAX_HEAP_SIZE: 1G
    hostname: cassandra-2
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - cqlsh
        - 127.0.0.1
        - "9042"
        - -e
        - SELECT release_version FROM system.local;
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 2m0s
    image: cassandra:5.0.9
    networks:
      cassandra-network: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 9042
        published: "10002"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: cassandra2-data
        target: /var/lib/cassandra
        volume: {}
  cassandra-3:
    build:
      context: D:\python\Projects\cmdd
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.cassandra
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    container_name: cassandra-3
    depends_on:
      cassandra-2:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CASSANDRA_CLUSTER_NAME: consistency-cluster
      CASSANDRA_DC: datacenter1
      CASSANDRA_RACK: rack1
      CASSANDRA_SEEDS: cassandra-1
      HEAP_NEWSIZE: 200M
      MAX_HEAP_SIZE: 1G
    hostname: cassandra-3
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - cqlsh
        - 127.0.0.1
        - "9042"
        - -e
        - SELECT release_version FROM system.local;
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 2m0s
    image: cmdd-cassandra-netadmin:5.0.9
    networks:
      cassandra-network: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 9042
        published: "10003"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: cassandra3-data
        target: /var/lib/cassandra
        volume: {}
networks:
  cassandra-network:
    name: cmdd_cassandra-network
    driver: bridge
volumes:
  cassandra1-data:
    name: cmdd_cassandra1-data-v2
  cassandra2-data:
    name: cmdd_cassandra2-data-v2
  cassandra3-data:
    name: cmdd_cassandra3-data-v2
